summary: The note describes a team-building Saturday held by the Westbrook Warriors, a local amateur soccer team, on September 14, 2023. The day included a scavenger hunt, a shared meal at Al's Diner, a surprise tribute to volunteers, a communication workshop, an arcade challenge and a sunset reflection. It argues that off-field social events build unity, mutual respect and team spirit for amateur teams.
one_line: The Westbrook Warriors soccer team spent September 14, 2023 on social team-building activities that strengthened unity beyond the pitch.
key_facts: The Westbrook Warriors, a local soccer team, held a team-building social outing on Saturday, September 14, 2023.
Team manager Emily Perkins organized the day and said, "we're not just teammates; we're a family."
The day began at Westbrook Park with a scavenger hunt in mixed-ability groups, with clues leading from the local library to the Westbrook Tower and other landmarks.
Team captain Jordan Matthews said he loved seeing teammates who are usually quiet on the pitch take charge and lead to the next clue.
The team ate a special banquet at Al's Diner, a local eatery known for supporting community activities, with pasta, salads and burgers.
Waitress and part-time photographer Lucy Hill captured candid moments of the team during the meal.
Emily and Jordan planned a surprise to honor volunteers, assistant coaches and supportive families, including equipment manager Mike Johnson.
Jordan Matthews handed out personalized gifts of appreciation to the unsung heroes of the team.
Local motivational speaker Eileen Sanders led a surprise workshop on collaboration and effective communication.
Midfielder Carlos Ramirez said the workshop opened his eyes to how he communicates on the pitch.
The team played arcade games such as air hockey and skee-ball at Westbrook Entertainment Center, which was reserved for them.
Defender Sophia Chen joked that goalie Alex is as good at defending at the air hockey table as on the soccer field.
The day ended on the grassy hill overlooking Westbrook Park, where each member shared favorite moments and aspirations for the upcoming season.
Newcomer Liam Parker said he already felt part of the Warrior family.
